directions.instruction: Ensure first-viewers immediately establish spatial relationships upon entering the synagogue: frame Jesus entering rear-left, seated watchful scribes along perimeter benches, and the man with the withered hand holding his affected left arm against his torso in quiet isolation.
Maintain intense visual focus on the scribes' hostile, calculating gazes. Their rigid seated postures along stone benches must clearly signal suspicious entrapment to first-time viewers.

Clear profile framing of Jesus inviting the man to step into the central floor space. Ensure the man's movement from the wall bench into the open center makes his vulnerability immediately obvious to the audience.
Keep Jesus' pivot toward the scribes sharp and authoritative. His open, questioning facial expression must contrast clearly with the closed, stonewalling demeanor of his accusers.

Highlight the uncomfortable, stubborn silence across the room. Scribes and onlookers must remain visibly frozen, avoiding eye contact or speech, so the dramatic tension of their refusal to answer is unmistakable.
Direct Jesus' facial performance to convey righteous indignation tempered with sorrow over their hard hearts before turning back to command the man, ensuring emotional clarity for the viewer.

Macro insert of the anatomical left hand extending and uncurling. High-contrast lighting must clearly show the miraculous transition from withered stiffness to complete anatomical wholeness in full view.
Frame the abrupt departure of the scribes through the main doors. Their hurried departure must clearly register as a dramatic escalation from silent opposition to active conspiracy.
Establish the dramatic shift in location to the open Sea of Galilee shoreline. Deep tracking wide shot must show the sheer scale of the regional crowd following Jesus and his disciples.
Keep Jesus' gesture toward the moored fishing boat explicit so viewers understand why a getaway/teaching vessel is being prepared to prevent crush safety hazards.
Handheld follow shot showing afflicted crowd members pressing forward to touch Jesus' mantle hem. Ensure visual clarity shows their desperate desire for physical healing rather than aggressive chaos.
Medium-close push-in as the possessed man drops to his knees before Jesus. Ensure his upturned face and agonized expression make the spiritual confrontation immediately legible before he cries out.
High-angle reverse shot of Jesus issuing his stern command of messianic secrecy, maintaining clear downward gaze continuity on the humbled kneeling man.
Wide panning shot establishing the mountain slope landscape. Ensure first-viewers clearly see Jesus leading the climb and looking back down to call those he selected.
Medium-close push-in on Jesus atop the mountain ridge delivering his formal commission to the Twelve, ensuring clear facial exposure for vocal performance clarity.
Frame Simon Peter, James, and John clearly in the front rank. Simon's one-step forward movement as he is named Peter must visibly register as a significant moment of designation.
Smooth tracking pan across the remaining nine apostles. Ensure each character's canonical color coding and distinctive props (such as Judas' waist pouch) are cleanly readable.

Wide push-in into the Capernaum home showing a claustrophobic crowd packing the floor and doorway. Staging must make visually obvious that physical space around the food table is completely obstructed.
Exterior medium-wide shot of bystanders outside the crowded doorway discussing incoming news of Jesus' family. Ensure exterior sightlines clearly distinguish crowd rumors outside from events inside.
Medium eye-level shot framing Jerusalem scribes clustered inside, pointing forefingers toward Jesus. Their arrogant postures must immediately communicate aggressive accusation.
Medium-close push-in as Jesus beckons the scribes closer and speaks in parables. Clear, unobscured face framing ensures first-viewers focus directly on his logic.
Static medium-close shot on Jesus maintaining intense eye contact while explaining the principle of a divided kingdom and house, holding unwavering composure.
Medium-close push-in on Jesus as he brings his wrists together in a symbolic binding motion before extending his palm, making his parable illustration visually legible.
Close-up static shot on Jesus delivering the solemn blasphemy warning concerning the Holy Spirit. Direct key light across his lips ensures maximum dramatic and linguistic clarity.
Pull-out medium shot revealing the stunned, silent reaction across the room. Scribes lowering their hands and looking down must clearly convey their rhetorical defeat.
Medium-wide threshold shot showing onlookers passing the message of family arrival along a human chain into the house, creating clear dramatic continuity for the message relay.
Low-angle pan-left shot following the message as a seated listener turns to relay it directly to Jesus, keeping the spatial chain of communication obvious to first-viewers.
Medium-close static shot on Jesus looking up with raised eyebrows in a rhetorical question posture, inviting the surrounding listeners into his upcoming teaching.
Medium-close pan-right shot tracking Jesus' sweeping gaze and open-armed circle gesture toward the seated crowd, visually establishing his new spiritual family circle.
Slow push-in on Jesus placing his right hand over his heart as he delivers his concluding thesis: whoever does God's will is his brother, sister, and mother.

directions.instruction: 35mm medium-wide low-angle tracking shot following behind Jesus as he enters through the rear-left threshold of the rectangular limestone synagogue, advancing 3 deliberate steps into the central aisle. Scribes sit rigidly along right stone wall benches while the man with the withered hand sits recessed rear-right, holding his anatomical left arm drawn tightly against his chest. Jesus wears his unbleached flax tunic with worn neckline, blue clavi, off-white mantle with blue corner gamma motifs and corner tzitzit, and low-ankle sandals. Principal scribe wears a charcoal robe with burgundy clavi; man with withered hand wears a coarse tan flax tunic with frayed hem, dark brown shawl, and cord belt. High-angle morning sun (5200K) keys from upper-left window apertures with volumetric dust beams; ambient stone bounce fill at +1.5 EV.

50mm medium over-the-shoulder shot past Jesus' left shoulder, slowly pushing in on seated scribes along the right wall stone bench. Feet flat on dirt floor, hands on knees, scribes tighten torsos and lock suspicious, hostile eyes screen-left toward Jesus with minimal facial movement. Middle-aged scribe holds a wooden tablet prop on his lap. Principal scribe wears a charcoal robe with burgundy clavi; middle-aged scribe wears a black tunic and draped mantle with dark red clavi and corner tassels; younger scribe wears a black ankle-length tunic with dark purple/red clavi and a cream wrapped turban. Directional key light from upper-left windows at 5200K grazes scribes' faces with soft background rim light; shadow fill maintained at -2 EV.

85mm medium-close profile shot at eye level, static framing keeping Jesus' face and mouth fully front-lit and unobscured for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment 567e1949-4ecb-4e9b-9dc9-2df5a3bdd2c5 ('Akiju kwei ba, aya ei yahagom yoho bei'). Jesus stands in the synagogue center, extending his right hand open-palmed. The man unclasps his right hand from his left wrist, rises from the stone bench, and steps 2 paces forward into the central floor space, halting 3 paces from Jesus. Jesus wears his light unbleached flax tunic with worn neck hem and blue clavi shoulder bands; man wears his coarse tan flax tunic, dark brown patterned shawl, and cord belt. High left window aperture keys at 5200K with soft limestone wall bounce fill.

50mm medium-close static shot centered on Jesus, face front-lit and clearly visible for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment 6563e2f8-0088-4c75-bd96-bfa8769e654c ('Puig Yahudi niggai serti...'). Jesus pivots his upper torso 45 degrees left away from the man to face the seated scribes squarely, raising his left hand slightly in a rhetorical teaching gesture while maintaining grounded posture. Scribes remain motionless in background left. Jesus wears his canonical unbleached flax tunic with worn neckline, blue clavi, and off-white draped mantle displaying corner tzitzit tassels. Direct key light path from upper window aperture at 5200K angled at 45 degrees illuminates lower face and lips; ambient bounce fill at -1.5 EV.

35mm medium reverse shot, high-angle perspective from Jesus' eye level looking screen-left at perimeter stone benches. Scribes and crowd witnesses sit in frozen, stoic silence, clenching robe fabric, with clenched jaws, refusing to nod or speak. Principal scribe wears a dark charcoal robe with burgundy clavi and corner tzitzit; stout scribe wears a charcoal tunic and dark mantle; stern crowd witness wears a brown flax tunic with cream draped mantle. Key light from upper right window at 5200K casts key/shadow split across scribes' faces; wall bounce fill kept low at -2.5 EV to emphasize stone-faced opposition.

85mm medium-close slow push-in on Jesus' face with full lip visibility for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment 3930cb5c-646b-48cc-b8ad-3f159efa8749 ('Atit anda'). Jesus sweeps his head in a 180-degree arc across the room with an expression of righteous anger mingled with sorrow over their hard hearts, before extending his right arm straight toward the man, gesturing for him to stretch out his hand. Man stands 3 paces away facing Jesus. Jesus wears his light flax tunic with worn neck hem, blue clavi, and cream mantle with blue corner motifs and corner tassels; man stands in coarse tan flax tunic and dark brown shawl. Focused key light from upper window aperture highlights eyes and mouth; warm floor bounce fill illuminates neck and tunic.

100mm macro insert close-up, static camera with shallow depth of field. The man's anatomical left hand and arm extend straight outward screen-right away from his torso; fingers uncurl, forearm muscles relax, and the anatomical left hand fully restores to complete physical wholeness in air. Sleeve of coarse woven tan flax tunic with frayed hem texture frames the extending arm. High-side key light at 5200K strikes the anatomical left hand directly with a 5:1 contrast ratio against softly exposed stone floor background.

24mm wide pull-out shot framing the main synagogue entrance doors rear-left. Scribes launch upward from perimeter benches, turn shoulders toward exit, and walk rapidly out through wooden double doors in a group cluster, leaving empty benches behind while Jesus stands in the central aisle. Principal scribe wears charcoal robe with burgundy clavi; middle-aged scribe wears black mantle; younger scribe wears black tunic with wrapped turban and waist reed pouch. High exterior morning sun (5500K) spills through open double doors, creating strong backlight silhouette on exiting scribes while indoor ambient key maintains exposure.

28mm wide tracking shot moving right alongside Jesus along the open Sea of Galilee shoreline under bright daylight. Jesus and lead disciples walk forward along sandy beach from screen-left to screen-right; dense regional crowd follows 5 paces behind. Small wooden fishing boat moored at water's edge in background left. Jesus wears light flax tunic and blue-trimmed cream mantle with corner tzitzit. Peter wears tan tunic and rust-brown mantle; James Zebedee wears cream tunic and terracotta-red mantle; John wears cream tunic with teal mantle stripes; Andrew wears pale cream tunic; Matthew wears stone-gray tunic and deep teal mantle. Crowd wears rustic brown and cream tunics. Direct 5600K daylight with strong upward water reflection fill (+1 EV) softening facial shadows.

50mm medium static shot at eye level, mouth readable for narration pacing. Jesus stands near wet sand, turning torso toward Peter and disciples screen-right. Jesus touches Peter's shoulder and gestures with left hand toward the wooden boat moored in shallow water background-left. Peter nods and turns hips to signal companions. Jesus wears light flax tunic and blue-striped mantle. Peter wears tan tunic and rust-brown mantle; James Zebedee wears terracotta mantle; John wears teal-trimmed mantle. Direct sun key at 5600K from upper right; soft fill from white sand and water bounce; subtle water shimmer highlights on boat.

35mm medium-wide handheld follow shot moving through crowd at eye level. Afflicted crowd members form a tight semicircle pressing forward from screen-left toward Jesus center-frame, reaching hands inward to touch outer hem of Jesus' mantle while Jesus steps back 1 pace toward water line. Jesus wears light flax tunic with blue clavi and cream mantle. Crowd witnesses wear rustic tan, brown, and cream flax tunics; crowd man (44a42fb6) wears tan tunic, cream mantle, and a 1st-century Levantine headwrap prop. Direct overhead sunlight (5600K) creating hair rim highlights with soft sand bounce fill across crowd faces.

50mm medium-close push-in shot, mouth completely unobscured for speaker lip-sync on audio segment ead1da4a-08a2-4ba2-b06b-3eee93e69d6b ('Nani ne Allah Nipmot ri!'). Possessed man steps out from crowd foreground-right, collapses to knees in wet sand before Jesus, planting hands in sand and tilting upturned face screen-left to shout. Possessed man wears heavily distressed torn coarse brown tunic with frayed neckline. Jesus wears light flax tunic, blue clavi, and cream mantle with corner tzitzit. Direct 5600K sun key from upper right illuminating kneeling man's face; sand bounce fill across Jesus standing above.

85mm medium-close reverse shot, static high-angle looking down from Jesus' perspective at kneeling man. Jesus stands upright, extending right hand downward in a firm stern silencing gesture; possessed man remains on knees with head bowed in submission. Jesus wears light flax tunic with blue clavi and cream mantle with blue corner motifs; possessed man wears torn coarse brown tunic. Direct upper sun key (5600K) casting downward rim light on Jesus' shoulders while keying lower face clearly; shadow fill from sand reflection.

24mm wide pan-right shot along grassy mountain ridge with high horizon line. Jesus steps up steep grassy incline, halting on elevated rocky outcrop upper-left. Disciples follow 10 paces behind on lower trail. Jesus turns hips and shoulders right to look back down at followers climbing upward. Jesus wears light flax tunic, blue clavi, cream mantle, low-ankle sandals. Peter wears rust-brown mantle; James Zebedee wears terracotta mantle; John wears teal-trimmed mantle. Natural direct golden-white daylight (5400K) across ridge with open sky ambient fill (6500K) softening shadowed side.

50mm medium-close slow push-in on Jesus atop mountain ridge facing screen-left, mouth centered and unobscured for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment 4997f3bc-45d8-4a4b-9348-907cd5846b59 ('Didimig je leu binhyepo...'). Jesus stands on central rocky elevation facing assembled disciples below, feet wide, opening arms wide in a sweeping commissioning gesture before bringing hands back to chest level. Jesus wears unbleached flax tunic with worn neckline, blue clavi, and cream draped mantle with corner tzitzit tassels. Direct 5400K sunlight 30 degrees off camera axis ensuring full facial illumination; sky ambient fill at 3:1 contrast.

35mm medium-wide static shot against mountain sky horizon. Simon Peter, James, and John stand in front rank screen-left facing Jesus center-right. Simon steps forward 1 pace as his name is pronounced Peter; James and John stand shoulder-to-shoulder nodding reverently. Simon Peter wears tan tunic and rust-brown draped mantle with tzitzit. James Zebedee wears cream tunic and terracotta-red mantle. John wears cream tunic with saturated teal mantle stripes and corner motifs. Jesus wears light flax tunic and cream mantle. Direct sun key (5400K) from upper left illuminating apostles on mountain peak with open sky ambient bounce fill.

35mm medium-wide tracking pan left-to-right across grassy mountain slope. Nine remaining apostles stand gathered in a cohesive arc across slope. Judas adjusts leather money bag cord at waist; Bartholomew turns shoulders toward camera; Matthew steps into alignment. Thaddaeus wears aubergine tunic and dusty-saffron mantle; James Alphaeus wears pale flax tunic and gray mantle; Bartholomew wears undyed tunic with olive neck trim and deep indigo mantle; Simon Zealot wears cream tunic and dark gray mantle; Philip wears mustard tunic and umber mantle; Andrew wears cream tunic and mantle; Thomas wears cream tunic and burgundy-striped mantle; Judas Iscariot wears olive tunic, dark wine-red mantle, and leather waist pouch; Matthew wears stone-gray tunic and deep teal mantle. Consistent mountain daylight (5400K) highlighting canonical color blocks without clipping under open sky.

28mm wide push-in shot from doorway elevation establishing Capernaum domestic interior. Dense crowd fills doorway rear-left and floor space completely. Jesus and disciples sit on floor center-frame, surrounded so tightly that access to low wooden table with untouched flatbread against right wall is completely obstructed. Jesus wears light flax tunic, blue clavi, cream mantle. John wears teal-trimmed mantle; Peter wears rust-brown mantle. Crowd witnesses wear rustic tan, brown, and cream flax tunics. Midday sun (5500K) streaming through doorway and roof slits with volumetric dust beams; mudbrick wall bounce fill at 4800K.

35mm medium-wide static exterior shot outside packed doorway threshold. Crowd members squeeze against doorway frame looking screen-right down exterior path; two bystanders gesticulate with open hands discussing incoming family rumors. Distant background path renders traveler silhouettes approaching to establish arrival continuity. Stern crowd spokesperson wears brown tunic and cream draped mantle with cord belt; young crowd man wears cream tunic and mantle; crowd man wears tan tunic and mantle. Bright midday sun (5600K) with warm ground bounce fill on doorway crowd.

50mm medium eye-level static shot inside near doorway, with post-production allocation for title card 'Yesus kin Beelzebul'. Jerusalem scribes stand clustered against interior wall, robes drawn tight, weight on back heels, tilting heads upward haughtily and pointing forefingers screen-right toward Jesus while delivering accusations. Principal scribe wears charcoal robe with burgundy clavi; younger scribe wears black tunic with burgundy clavi and cream wrapped turban; stout scribe wears charcoal tunic and mantle. Directional key from open doorway at 5500K grazing dark robes, with warm interior wall bounce fill at -2 EV on faces.

85mm medium-close push-in on Jesus' face, mouth centered and clearly lit for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment bd5f38cd-9ec6-48fa-9fa5-05eb445c97c1 ('Notou mem gima Bilis...'). Jesus sits upright on floor, shifting weight forward onto shins to face scribes standing screen-left, beckoning with right hand to gesture them closer before opening palms upward in parabolic question pose. Jesus wears light flax tunic with worn neck hem, blue clavi, and off-white mantle. Principal scribe wears charcoal robe with burgundy clavi. Key light from high roof aperture at 5200K directly overhead and forward of Jesus; earthen floor fill maintaining 3.5:1 ratio.

85mm medium-close static shot centered on Jesus' face and lips for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment 120a6879-7fb5-4cc5-9f84-5483d11d4a90. Jesus remains seated facing scribes screen-left, maintaining unwavering gaze and intense eye contact, gesturing with right hand moving inward to outward to illustrate division before resting palm on knee. Jesus wears unbleached flax tunic with worn neckline, blue clavi, and cream draped mantle with blue corner motifs. Overhead roof aperture key (5200K) with subtle volumetric dust motes in key beam; steady facial illumination for teaching speech.

50mm medium-close push-in on Jesus, maintaining mouth visibility and waist-up posture for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment c66bfc2f-4360-485f-a5cd-06c3b3125006. Jesus brings wrists together in front of chest in a symbolic binding motion before extending right palm outward toward audience, gesturing emphasis. Jesus wears light flax tunic with blue clavi shoulder stripes and cream mantle. Overhead roof light key (5200K) angled to highlight face and wrists during binding gesture; warm mudbrick bounce fill.

100mm close-up static shot centered on Jesus' face, direct key light across lips for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment b0814469-70f2-4066-ab52-bb8cd92836ea ('Noro Noni mikos ser sisar...'). Tight framing on Jesus' face with solemn expression and upright neck alignment, delivering solemn blasphemy warning with precise jaw and lip articulation. Jesus wears unbleached flax tunic with worn neck hem and blue clavi. Direct keying from roof opening at 5200K highlighting eyes and lips clearly, supported by soft warm ambient bounce fill.

35mm medium room pull-out shot capturing tense atmosphere. Scribes in foreground-left lower outstretched hands and drop heads in stunned silence; crowd seated on floor turns heads slowly between scribes and Jesus in complete room stilling. Principal scribe wears black robe with burgundy clavi; middle-aged scribe wears dark mantle; stern crowd man wears brown tunic and cream mantle; Jesus wears light flax tunic with blue clavi. Dual source key from doorway rear-left and overhead roof aperture, with warm mudbrick wall fill illuminating silent room.

35mm medium-wide static threshold shot, with post-production allocation for title card 'Yesus nipmem kin nikinjoi bat nya'. Onlookers packed at doorway threshold turn torsos inward, passing verbal message hand-to-mouth along a physical human chain from outside into the room. Stern crowd spokesperson wears brown tunic with cream mantle; young crowd man wears cream tunic and mantle. High exterior daylight (5600K) spilling through doorway keying threshold onlookers from behind, with interior floor bounce on message relayers.

50mm medium pan-left floor shot tracking message relayers at low camera height matching floor seating. Seated crowd member near door turns torso left to whisper to neighbor, who turns and leans forward toward seated Jesus center-frame to deliver the message. Stern crowd spokesperson wears brown tunic and cream mantle; crowd man wears tan tunic and cream mantle; older crowd woman wears tan dress and cream headscarf; Jesus wears light flax tunic and blue clavi. Soft warm directional daylight (5200K) entering from doorway with gentle floor mat bounce fill.

85mm medium-close static shot on seated Jesus, face and lips framed cleanly for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment c7e2a204-afdb-4bc5-bd43-17772a2fe64b ('Ningat ne dipmem...'). Jesus sits centered on floor mat, chest lifted, head tilted slightly upward looking screen-right toward crowd member, raising eyebrows in rhetorical query pose with open palms. Jesus wears light flax tunic with worn neckline, blue clavi, and cream mantle. Elder crowd witness wears terracotta tunic and cream draped mantle. Overhead roof aperture key at 5200K angled onto seated Jesus, face and mouth clearly illuminated.

50mm medium-close pan-right shot tracking Jesus' gaze, mouth visible for dialogue lip-sync on audio segment d4574261-831f-454b-8564-70778bc2cf10 ('Yo dini ne dipmem...'). Jesus rotates upper torso smoothly on waist axis, extending both arms outward in a broad open circle toward believers seated on floor around him. Jesus wears light flax tunic and blue-trimmed cream mantle. Older woman wears brown dress, rust inner headscarf, cream outer veil; young woman wears cream dress and cream veil. Key light from doorway and roof apertures at 5200K sweeping across seated believers with warm front exposure.

85mm medium-close slow push-in on Jesus, direct eye-level framing with full lip readability for dialogue lip-sync on final audio segment 5dd44635-d9ee-4628-a2c1-62a4f0e41fc9. Jesus brings hands inward from open circle gesture, placing right palm gently over heart while leaning upper torso forward toward circle of seated listeners to conclude teaching. Jesus wears unbleached flax tunic with worn neck hem, blue clavi, and cream mantle with corner tzitzit. Stern crowd spokesperson wears brown tunic. Overhead roof aperture key at 5200K focused on Jesus' face and hand over heart, with soft 3:1 earthen wall fill.

entries.summary: Mark Chapter 3 follows an emotional progression of rising hostility, expansive public ministry, divine appointment, intense spiritual conflict, and redefined spiritual community. Scene 1 (Mark 3:1-6) establishes tense Sabbath hostility in the synagogue, ending in a solemn miracle and lethal conspiracy. Scene 2 (Mark 3:7-12) broadens into the energetic press of vast, hopeful crowds by the Sea of Galilee. Scene 3 (Mark 3:13-19) transitions to a serene and solemn mountain commissioning of the Twelve Apostles. Scene 4 (Mark 3:20-30) escalates into severe ideological confrontation inside a crowded Capernaum home as Jerusalem scribes level accusations of demonic collusion, answered by Jesus's piercing parables and grave warning on unpardonable sin. Scene 5 (Mark 3:31-35) resolves in an intimate reframing of true family around doing God's will.

directions.instruction: Before: Synagogue exterior/entryway empty before arrival. Transition: Jesus enters through rear threshold walking toward central floor space. Eyelines: Jesus looks ahead toward seated group; scribes watch from side benches. Sourced fact: Jesus enters synagogue; man with withered hand present. Staging choice: Central stone aisle walkway and morning dust beams.

Before: Scribes seated watching Jesus' entrance. Transition: Scribes adjust posture to fixed, silent scrutiny. Eyelines: Directed screen-left toward Jesus. Sourced fact: Scribes watch Jesus to see if he heals on Sabbath. Staging choice: Seated along perimeter stone benching.

Before: Jesus standing central; man seated on bench. Transition: Jesus turns to address the man directly. Eyelines: Direct diagonal gaze between Jesus and the man. Sourced fact: Jesus speaks 'Come here' to man with withered hand. Staging choice: Open hand invitation gesture by Jesus.

Before: Jesus facing man with withered hand. Transition: Jesus pivots hips 45 degrees toward scribes. Eyelines: Jesus looks directly at scribes. Sourced fact: Jesus asks whether it is lawful on Sabbath to do good or harm. Staging choice: Hands raised outward at chest height.

Before: Jesus delivering rhetorical question. Transition: Scribes tense shoulders and maintain silence. Eyelines: Scribes avert direct gaze or look forward sternly. Sourced fact: Scribes remain silent. Staging choice: Folded arms and tight lip setting.

Before: Scribes silent. Transition: Jesus sweeps gaze around room with grief/anger, then turns to man and extends right arm. Eyelines: Jesus looks across scribes before locking gaze on man. Sourced fact: Jesus looks with anger, grieved at hardness of heart, commands 'Stretch out your hand'. Staging choice: Slow head turn sweep.

Before: Man's anatomical left arm drawn to chest with withered fingers. Transition: Man extends left forearm; fingers uncurl into complete anatomical restoration. Eyelines: Focused tightly on hand. Sourced fact: Hand stretched out and restored. Staging choice: Close insert framing on uncurling fingers.

Before: Miracle restored man's hand. Transition: Pharisees/scribes stand abruptly and exit synagogue. Eyelines: Directed toward rear exit doors. Sourced fact: Pharisees go out immediately to conspire against him. Staging choice: Brisk walking stride into door shadows.

Before: Synagogue exit in Capernaum. Transition: Relocate to Sea of Galilee shoreline; Jesus leads disciples with crowd following. Eyelines: Shoreline forward trajectory. Sourced fact: Jesus withdraws to sea; great crowd follows. Staging choice: Small Galilean fishing boat docked in shallow background surf.

Before: Walking along shoreline. Transition: Jesus pauses near waterline, turning to direct Peter and John regarding boat preparation. Eyelines: Jesus looks screen-right at disciples. Sourced fact: Instructs disciples to have boat ready to prevent crushing. Staging choice: Boat grounded 2 meters behind in shallow surf.

Before: Jesus talking with disciples. Transition: Afflicted crowds surge forward reaching toward Jesus. Eyelines: Multitude looks at Jesus; Jesus steps back half-pace. Sourced fact: Many healed; all with diseases press around to touch him. Staging choice: Dynamic handheld follow shot in crowd press.

Before: Crowds pressing forward. Transition: Possessed man falls to knees on gravel, shouting cry. Eyelines: Possessed man looks upward at Jesus; mouth visible for lip sync. Sourced fact: Unclean spirits fall down and cry 'You are the Son of God'. Staging choice: Sudden drop onto shore pebbles.

Before: Possessed man shouting on knees. Transition: Jesus extends hand downward in firm gesture of quiet restraint. Eyelines: Jesus looks down at kneeling man. Sourced fact: Strictly ordered them not to make him known. Staging choice: Measured palm gesture downward.

Before: Shoreline environment. Transition: Relocate to mountain slope; Jesus ascends trail and turns to call desired followers. Eyelines: Jesus looks down slope; followers look up. Sourced fact: Went up mountain and called those he desired. Staging choice: Grassy rocky ridge ascent trajectory.

Before: Followers climbing toward Jesus. Transition: Jesus stands elevated on ridge, speaking commission to assembled group. Eyelines: Jesus looks out over gathered disciples. Sourced fact: Appointed twelve to be with him, preach, and have authority over demons. Staging choice: Open-handed teaching stance.

Before: General commissioning speech. Transition: Simon steps forward as Peter; James and John step forward as Boanerges. Eyelines: Three disciples look toward Jesus screen-left. Sourced fact: Appointed Simon (Peter), James son of Zebedee, and John (Boanerges). Staging choice: Prominent three-man grouping at ridge center.

Before: Naming of inner three. Transition: Camera sweeps across remaining nine apostles assembled on slope. Eyelines: Disciples look attentively toward Jesus. Sourced fact: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon Zealot, Judas Iscariot. Staging choice: Semi-circular positioning showing locked costume details (Matthew's wax tablet, Judas' pouch).

Before: Mountain ridge. Transition: Relocate to Capernaum home interior; crowd fills room, untouched bread sits on low table. Eyelines: People looking inward; Jesus in room center. Sourced fact: Went home; crowd gathered again so they could not even eat. Staging choice: Low wooden table with flatbread center floor.

Before: Interior crowd congestion. Transition: Onlookers outside doorway converse regarding family arrival. Eyelines: Looking toward doorway entry gap. Sourced fact: Family heard and went out to seize him, saying he is out of his mind. Staging choice: Exterior mudbrick doorway grouping.

Before: Exterior family reports. Transition: Jerusalem scribes stand near interior doorway leveling accusations. Eyelines: Scribes look screen-left toward Jesus. Sourced fact: Scribes from Jerusalem say he is possessed by Beelzebul and casts out demons by prince of demons. Staging choice: Cluttered scribal cluster in dark mantles.

Before: Scribes accusing from doorway. Transition: Jesus beckons scribes closer and speaks parable question. Eyelines: Jesus looks screen-left at scribes; mouth visible for lip sync. Sourced fact: Called them and spoke in parables: 'How can Satan cast out Satan?'. Staging choice: Beckoning hand gesture.

Before: Opening parable question. Transition: Jesus explains divided kingdom and house principles with opening/separating palm gestures. Eyelines: Jesus faces scribes directly. Sourced fact: Kingdom or house divided cannot stand; Satan divided comes to end. Staging choice: Separating palm movements.

Before: Divided kingdom explanation. Transition: Jesus mimes binding action and forward sweep. Eyelines: Fixed on scribes and listeners. Sourced fact: No one plunders strong man's house without first binding him. Staging choice: Crossed wrist binding mime gesture.

Before: Strong man illustration. Transition: Close-up on Jesus delivering solemn warning on Holy Spirit blasphemy. Eyelines: Straight into lens/audience. Sourced fact: All sins forgiven except blasphemy against Holy Spirit, which is eternal sin. Staging choice: Direct intimate eye contact.

Before: Jesus delivering grave warning. Transition: Scribes and crowd freeze in silent reaction. Eyelines: Scribes drop gaze or stare tensed. Sourced fact: For they said 'He has an unclean spirit'. Staging choice: Stunned silent freeze across room.

Before: Room reaction to Jesus' speech. Transition: Threshold witness turns outward to receive message, then turns inward to relay. Eyelines: Threshold witness looks outward then inward. Sourced fact: Mother and brothers arrived outside and called for him. Staging choice: Message passing gesture at doorframe.

Before: Message passed through threshold. Transition: Seated crowd members turn to Jesus and state message. Eyelines: Crowd looks toward seated Jesus in room center. Sourced fact: Crowd sitting around him said 'Your mother and brothers are outside seeking you'. Staging choice: Sequential head turn across floor mats.

Before: Crowd relaying message. Transition: Jesus pauses, tilts head upward, and asks question. Eyelines: Jesus looks upward across crowd circle. Sourced fact: Jesus answered 'Who are my mother and my brothers?'. Staging choice: Cross-legged seated composure on floor mat.

Before: Jesus asking question. Transition: Jesus sweeps head and open arms across seated listeners. Eyelines: Panning gaze across 180-degree circle. Sourced fact: Looking at those sat around him, said 'Here are my mother and my brothers!'. Staging choice: Smooth sweeping arm motion over seated group.

Before: Open embrace gesture. Transition: Jesus draws palms inward near chest in warm concluding affirmation. Eyelines: Gentle eye-level gaze across listeners. Sourced fact: Whoever does will of God is brother, sister, and mother. Staging choice: Palms resting near chest in intimate resolution.

directions.instruction: Medium-wide tracking shot on 35mm lens tracking left-to-right following Jesus entering the synagogue from the rear entryway stage left, walking 3 meters along the central stone aisle toward stage right. Scribes sit aligned on stone benches stage right; man with withered hand sits isolated on bench stage left. Jesus wears off-white un-dyed flax tunic with frayed neckline, thin rope belt, and draped blue-striped mantle with corner tzitzit. Scribes wear solid charcoal/black draped wool robes with magenta clavi and corner tassels. Man with Withered Hand wears coarse beige linen tunic with frayed hem, brown striped open vest overlay, and bare feet. High-angled warm morning sunlight (3400K) filters through high stone clerestory windows screen-left with soft limestone wall bounce fill (5200K) at 3:1 contrast ratio, illuminating visible dust motes in key beam.

Medium shot on 50mm lens with slow dolly push-in toward scribes seated along stone benching stage right, 2 meters from center aisle, backs against limestone wall. Scribes adjust posture into fixed, silent scrutiny; heads turn in unison with eyelines locked off-screen left toward Jesus. Principal Scribe, Middle-Aged Tablet Scribe, and Younger Lean Scribe wear dark charcoal/black wool tunics and mantles with magenta clavi and white corner tassels; Younger Scribe wears off-white wrapped linen turban. Lit with cool ambient fill from stone wall reflections (5000K) and subtle key rim from high windows at 4:1 key-to-fill contrast.

Medium-close eye-level shot on 85mm lens, static framing with mouth clearly visible for dialogue lip sync. Jesus stands in central synagogue floor space, extending right hand in inviting gesture while turning torso 15 degrees toward man with withered hand, who rises from stage-left bench 2 meters away. Jesus wears off-white tunic and blue-striped mantle; Man with Withered Hand wears textured beige tunic with raw frayed edges, narrow sash belt, and brown striped vest overlay. Direct beam of warm sunlight (3400K) keys Jesus in central space at 2.5:1 key-to-fill ratio, casting warm facial bounce and clear catchlights.

Medium-close shot on 85mm lens, camera pivoting slightly screen-left, keeping Jesus centered with mouth unblocked for dialogue lip sync. Jesus stands central, pivoting hips 30 degrees screen-left toward seated scribes on stage-right bench, turning shoulders and extending hands outward at chest height. Jesus wears off-white frayed tunic, rope belt, and blue-striped mantle with corner tzitzit. Consistent warm synagogue key beam screen-left on Jesus with exposure locked to shot 3, key highlighting face and mouth clearly during speech.

Medium reaction shot on 50mm lens, reverse angle looking screen-right across scribes and crowd. Scribes and crowd members sit along stage-right stone bench facing Jesus; static seated contact, lips pressed tightly, shoulders tensed upward 1 cm, in silent refusal to speak. Scribes retain charcoal/black wool draped mantles with magenta clavi; Crowd Spokesperson wears brown flax tunic and off-white draped mantle with thin leather cord belt. Cool shadow fill (5000K) with strong edge rim from high screen-left windows at 4:1 contrast ratio heightening silent tension.

Medium-close slow push-in on 85mm lens, capturing Jesus' grieved expression. Jesus stands central, turning head slowly left-to-right in 180-degree sweep from stage-right scribes to stage-left man, chest rising with grieved breath, re-orienting toward man and extending right arm. Jesus in canonical blue-trimmed mantle and cream tunic; Man with Withered Hand in coarse beige tunic with brown-striped vest overlay. Warm 3400K key beam accentuates grieved expression and eye catchlights with soft warm fill maintaining 3:1 key-to-fill ratio.

Close insert shot on 100mm macro lens, static framing sharply focused on hand restoration. Man stands 1.5 meters from Jesus; anatomical left arm extends straight forward from chest level toward center frame as withered left fingers gradually uncurl and stretch until fully straightened and restored. Frayed cuff of coarse beige tunic and edge of brown-striped vest frame extending forearm and palm. Direct key light from high window beam (3400K) illuminates forearm and uncurling fingers against soft shadowed background.

Wide shot on 28mm lens, camera pulling back smoothly. Scribes and Pharisees push up abruptly from stage-right benches, turn 180 degrees away from Jesus, and march briskly 5 meters along side aisle to exit rear double doors at stage left into shadow. Full-length charcoal/black draped wool mantles with corner tassels and low-ankle leather sandals moving into door shadow. Warm window beams cut across dust while scribes move into cooler shadowed doorway space (4500K) as they exit.

Wide tracking shot on 24mm lens, lateral dolly moving right establishing shoreline. Jesus leads disciples along pebbled Galilee waterline moving left to right; vast crowd streams down grassy embankment from stage top-right. Small fishing boat docked in shallow surf in background. Jesus in off-white tunic and blue mantle; Peter (rust-brown mantle over tan tunic), John (teal/slate-blue striped mantle), James (terracotta-red mantle), Matthew (stone-gray tunic, deep-teal mantle); crowd in earthy brown, terracotta, rust, and cream tunics. Jesus stands on gravel shoreline facing Peter and John screen-right, pointing right hand toward small fishing boat grounded 2 meters behind in shallow surf; disciples nod and step back toward vessel. Jesus in blue-striped mantle; Peter (rust-brown mantle), John (teal/slate mantle), James (terracotta mantle), Andrew (cream mantle), Matthew (stone-gray tunic, wax tablet tucked at belt). Bright shoreline lighting; 5600K key light from high screen-right, subtle water bounce on Jesus and disciples, 2:1 fill ratio.

Direct overhead sun screen-right keying possessed man on ground; soft sand bounce fill on lower face, bright exterior exposure.

Jesus stands anchored center frame over kneeling man, extending right hand downward in motion of silent restraint, closing palm into quiet commanding prohibition. Jesus in off-white frayed tunic and blue-striped mantle; Man with Unclean Spirit in tattered brown linen kneeling on gravel. Overhead sun keying Jesus from top screen-left; soft water rim on hair and shoulders, matched 5600K exterior color temperature.

Jesus in cream tunic and blue mantle surrounded by apostles and crowd members in earthy tunics, brown wool dresses, and cream veils. Warm midday sun (3800K) beaming through doorway screen-left and roof openings; dusty air rays, shadow falloff into room corners (4:1 contrast).

Crowd members gather outside mudbrick home doorway at stage right, leaning against exterior walls; two crowd witnesses lean toward each other, whispering with subtle hand gestures toward entry gap. Crowd witnesses including Stern Spokesperson in brown tunic and cream mantle, Young Man in off-white cream tunic and draped mantle. Jerusalem scribes stand in tight cluster by interior doorway at stage left, facing Jesus across 3 meters of floor space; Principal Scribe steps forward half-pace, extending finger accusingly toward Jesus. Scribes in solid charcoal/black draped wool robes with magenta clavi, corner tassels, and Younger Scribe's wrapped off-white linen turban. Soft warm doorway bounce screen-left on scribes with moody ambient shadows behind them; 4.5:1 key-to-fill ratio.

Jesus stands center room, beckoning with right hand for scribes to step closer (scribes step forward 1 meter from doorway), then gesturing with open palms as he asks his opening parable question. Jesus in cream tunic and blue mantle facing Principal Scribe in charcoal/black draped wool mantle with magenta clavi. Central roof beam light (3600K) keying Jesus in center floor; dark surrounding background heightening focus, soft earth bounce fill.

Medium-close static shot on 85mm lens, maintaining 180-degree axis, lip sync unobstructed. Jesus remains centered in home interior, facing scribes with steady horizontal sightline, bringing palms together then separating them outward in dividing gesture to explain divided kingdom/house. Jesus in canonical off-white flax tunic and blue-striped mantle with corner tzitzit standing in central floor space. Jesus sweeping gaze across seated listeners including Older Woman in rust headscarf and cream veil, and Young Woman in un-dyed cream dress and head veil. entries.summary: Mark Chapter 3 moves through five distinct emotional and thematic movements: tense Sabbath hostility in the Capernaum synagogue ending in a restorative miracle and conspiracy (Mark 3:1-6); the energetic, desperate press of vast crowds at the Sea of Galilee shoreline (Mark 3:7-12); the serene, authoritative commissioning of the Twelve Apostles on a sunlit mountain ridge (Mark 3:13-19); severe ideological conflict inside a packed Capernaum home where Jerusalem scribes accuse Jesus of demonic power, answered by His piercing parables and grave warning on unpardonable sin (Mark 3:20-30); and an intimate, reassuring redefinition of true spiritual family around those who do the will of God (Mark 3:31-35).

entries.summary: Mark 3 follows a 5-stage emotional arc: tight tension and sorrow during the synagogue Sabbath healing confrontation (vv. 1-6); kinetic press and clamor along the Sea of Galilee shore (vv. 7-12); majestic, solemn calling on the mountain peak (vv. 13-19); dark opposition, severe parabolic warnings, and accusations of Beelzebul in Capernaum (vv. 20-30); and warm spiritual intimacy redefining the true family of God within the house circle (vv. 31-35).

entries.summary: As HeartWord script supervisor for Mark 3 (Hatam), I have independently verified continuity, character entrance/exit states, costume specs, speaker assignments, prop management, title card overlays, and physical state transitions across all 30 shots spanning the chapter's five narrative environments. Key continuity checkpoints include: (1) Synagogue healing sequence (vv. 1-6): strict enforcement of the anatomical LEFT hand pre-healing affliction for character 7da26e65-8f61-4820-b579-404bd4d310de, transitioning to complete restoration at shot 91afa1de-a013-4266-81e8-7e6be3199c7e before scribal exit; (2) Galilee shoreline (vv. 7-12): boat prop pre-positioning at shot cec159dc-4d9d-4daf-a7bc-63aac1ed401b and voice attribution for the possessed man's cry at shot ffb0efa5-17ed-455a-a444-2f206a8643fd; (3) Mountain appointment (vv. 13-19): character garment and accessory continuity across all twelve named apostles, including Judas Iscariot's waist pouch and Matthew's belt-tucked wax tablet; (4) Capernaum scribal confrontation (vv. 20-30): insertion of Dan-approved on-screen title card 'Yesus kin Beelzebul' at shot 6a701e3e-5380-4afc-a7be-ae6f500e7e8e without audio narration; and (5) Spiritual family circle (vv. 31-35): insertion of Dan-approved on-screen title card 'Yesus nipmem kin nikinjoi bat nya' at shot 415f274d-89ce-4eb0-8c0d-1e7bd50b7b03, transitioning from standing crowded threshold to intimate floor-seated teaching circle around Jesus.

entries.summary: Picture editing plan for Mark 3 (Hatam) establishes a 30-shot cutting rhythm and visual assembly structure across five distinct narrative movements: (1) Synagogue Sabbath healing (shots 1-8): tension-building cuts between observing scribes and Jesus, establishing a steady, formal edit rhythm that holds reactively on silent pauses before hitting the close insert on the restoring left hand; (2) Sea of Galilee shoreline (shots 9-13): fluid, dynamic cuts reflecting the physical press and clamor of the crowds, with precise sync alignment for the possessed man's cry ('You are the Son of God'); (3) Mountain appointment of the twelve (shots 14-17): majestic, deliberate pacing with long-form cuts across the chosen disciples and clear lip sync mapping for Jesus' commission speech; (4) Capernaum scribal confrontation (shots 18-25): tight, sharp cuts highlighting scribal hostility, with graphics overlay for title card 'Yesus kin Beelzebul' (source-title:2) over shot 18 and unhindered lip sync framing during parabolic dialogue; and (5) Spiritual family circle (shots 26-30): intimate, eye-level circular cuts with graphics overlay for title card 'Yesus nipmem kin nikinjoi bat nya' (source-title:3) over shot 26, ending in a warm push-in as Jesus redefines true kinship.

directions.instruction: Medium-wide tracking shot with 28mm lens at eye level. Camera tracks forward slowly behind Jesus entering stage left into the synagogue interior. Jesus steps 3 paces down the central aisle; scribes are seated on perimeter stone wall benches stage right; man with withered left hand sits on low bench stage center-left holding his affected wrist against his torso. Jesus wears an unbleached cream flax tunic with a frayed collar and blue vertical clavi shoulder bands under a light unbleached draped mantle. Man with withered hand wears a coarse earthy beige tunic, dark brown striped shawl, and rope belt. Principal Scribe and stout older Scribe wear solid dark charcoal-grey tunics and unstitched draped mantles with burgundy clavi and tzitzit. Crowd witness wears a tan tunic and off-white mantle with a leather cord belt. Lighting features motivated morning daylight (3800K, +1.0 EV key) filtering at 45 degrees from high stone clerestory windows stage right, creating visible dusty shafts across the limestone floor against cool shadow fill (5500K, -1.5 EV).

Medium shot with 50mm prime lens at eye level, slowly pushing in on seated scribes along wall benches. Three scribes sit side-by-side stage right with torsos inclined forward 15 degrees left toward the central aisle. Eyelines are directed screen left toward Jesus with rigid, calculating postures. Principal Scribe wears a solid black/charcoal wool tunic and unstitched mantle with burgundy clavi and corner tzitzit. Scribe (middle-aged) wears a charcoal tunic while cradling a plain wooden wax tablet. Scribe (younger) wears a dark charcoal long tunic with double clavi and a white wrapped turban headpiece. Directional 3800K key light (+1.0 EV) from high window stage right casts sharp sidelight across faces, while cool shadow fill (5500K, -1.5 EV) emphasizes suspicious facial contours.

Medium-close static framing using an 85mm portrait telephoto lens at eye level. Lower face and mouth remain completely unobstructed for lip sync accuracy (sourceSegmentId 567e1949-4ecb-4e9b-9dc9-2df5a3bdd2c5). Jesus stands upright in the central aisle facing the man seated 4 paces away stage right; Jesus extends his right arm forward with open palm facing upward in a welcoming summons gesture as the man rises into the aisle. Jesus wears his canonical cream flax tunic with blue clavi and light mantle over left shoulder. Man wears an earthy beige coarse tunic and dark brown shawl, keeping his affected anatomical left hand drawn inward against his chest. Key-lit from high window stage right (3800K, +1.0 EV) with soft wall-bounce fill (4500K, -1.0 EV).

Medium-close static framing using an 85mm telephoto lens at eye level. Mouth and lower jaw are kept unobstructed and sharply focused for lip sync alignment (sourceSegmentId 6563e2f8-0088-4c75-bd96-bfa8769e654c). Jesus pivots 25 degrees stage left from the central aisle toward the perimeter benches, gesturing broadly with his left arm toward the seated religious leaders as he poses his Sabbath question. Jesus wears his worn cream flax tunic with blue vertical clavi shoulder bands and unbleached draped mantle. Stage right window beam provides 3800K key (+1.0 EV) with warm shoulder rim light against the shadowed stone background (-1.5 EV).

Medium reverse shot with 50mm prime lens at eye level, preserving the 180-degree optical axis across the synagogue floor. Group of scribes and onlookers sit on stone wall benches stage right, torsos upright, hands folded tightly across waists, jawlines tightened, refusing any verbal or physical response. Principal Scribe and stout Scribe wear dark charcoal tunics and mantles with burgundy clavi. Crowd witness sits beside them in a tan tunic and off-white mantle with leather cord belt. Directional key from high window stage left (3800K, +0.8 EV) with deep shadow fill (-2.0 EV) creates high-contrast chiaroscuro framing across silent expressions.

Medium-close framing with 85mm portrait lens, executing a slow push-in on Jesus' face. Lower face remains unobstructed for lip sync (sourceSegmentId 3930cb5c-646b-48cc-b8ad-3f159efa8749). directions.instruction: Spatial layout: Rectangular limestone synagogue interior with perimeter stone benches. Entrances/exits: Jesus enters from rear doorway screen-left. Actor positions: Jesus enters screen-left; scribes (Principal scribe, Stout scribe) and crowd witnesses (Stern spokesperson, Man with Withered Hand) sit on perimeter stone benches screen-right. Prop positions: Lined stone benches against limestone walls. Sightlines: Jesus looks screen-right toward central hall; scribes look screen-left at Jesus with hostile scrutiny. Movement path: Jesus steps through threshold screen-left, taking measured strides forward to central floor space screen-right.

Prop positions: Stone bench along limestone wall. Sightlines: All three scribes lock sightlines screen-left toward central floor space. Movement path: Static seated positioning; heads tilt slightly screen-left with furrowed brows while body postures remain rigid and unmoving.

Spatial layout: Central synagogue floor space facing wall benches. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus stands screen-left facing screen-right; Man with Withered Hand sits screen-right facing Jesus. Prop positions: Open stone floor; perimeter benches in background. Sightlines: Jesus looks screen-right directly at the man; man looks back screen-left at Jesus. Movement path: Jesus swivels chest screen-right, extending open palm toward the man to call him into the center space without physical contact.

Spatial layout: Central synagogue floor space in front of perimeter benches. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus stands centered screen-left, turning upper body screen-left to face scribes. Prop positions: Central aisle stone floor. Sightlines: Jesus turns gaze screen-left toward seated religious leaders. Movement path: Jesus pivots torso screen-left, raising open hands to chest level while speaking, keeping lower face and mouth fully illuminated for clear lip sync.

Spatial layout: Synagogue perimeter stone bench framing religious leaders. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Principal scribe, Stout scribe, and Stern spokesperson sit clustered screen-right. Prop positions: Wall bench against limestone wall. Sightlines: Leaders stare rigidly screen-left toward Jesus. Spatial layout: Tight detail space over man's left arm and chest. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Man with Withered Hand's anatomical left arm centered in frame. Actor positions: Kneeling man foreground screen-left; Jesus stands background screen-right looking down. Prop positions: Sandy beach ground. Sightlines: Jesus looks down screen-left toward disciples; disciples look up screen-right toward Jesus. Movement path: Jesus extends open arms in commissioning gesture, speaking appointment words with clear lip-sync visibility under direct golden daylight.

Prop positions: Mountain turf and rocks. Sightlines: Disciples look screen-right toward Jesus standing off-screen. Movement path: Subtle shoulder shifts and attentive turning movements as camera tracks laterally across the group.

Sightlines: Crowd looks inward toward table and Jesus. Movement path: Crowd jostles tightly in cramped space, preventing access to food on low wooden table.

Spatial layout: Exterior dirt path outside mudbrick house doorway. Entrances/exits: House doorway threshold screen-right. Actor positions: Crowd witnesses stand screen-left outside doorway. Prop positions: Exterior mudbrick wall and door frame. Sightlines: People look screen-left toward approaching path, then turn screen-right toward house interior. Movement path: Witnesses lean against exterior wall, whispering and pointing screen-left toward approaching family off-screen.

Spatial layout: Inside house doorway threshold. Entrances/exits: Interior entry threshold screen-left. Actor positions: Principal scribe, Younger scribe, and Stout scribe stand clustered screen-left near entryway. Prop positions: Interior mudbrick walls and door frame. Sightlines: Scribes glare screen-right toward Jesus in central room. Movement path: Scribes stand rigid with arms folded across chests, chins tilted upward in hostile, accusatory postures.

Spatial layout: Central room space inside house facing entryway scribes. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus stands screen-right facing screen-left; Principal scribe stands screen-left. Prop positions: Low wooden table and floor mats background. Sightlines: Jesus looks screen-left directly at scribes; scribes look screen-right. Movement path: Jesus takes one step forward screen-left toward scribes, extending left arm in parabolic gesture while delivering lip-synced question 'How can Satan cast out Satan?'.

Spatial layout: Central interior space of house. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus stands centered in medium close framing. Prop positions: Earthen floor and background crowd figures. Sightlines: Jesus maintains steady eyeline screen-left toward scribes. Movement path: Jesus swivels torso slightly left and right, hands gesturing to illustrate divided kingdom and divided house, with mouth clear for lip sync.

Spatial layout: Central room space facing crowd and scribes. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus stands centered screen-right facing screen-left. Prop positions: Surrounding house interior elements. Sightlines: Jesus addresses listening crowd and scribes screen-left. Movement path: Jesus clasps right hand over left wrist in binding motion, then spreads arms wide to illustrate plundering the strong man's house, mouth visible for lip sync.

Spatial layout: Close portrait framing inside house under window beam. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus centered in frame facing screen-center/left. Prop positions: Background mudbrick wall texture. Sightlines: Jesus locks gaze forward screen-left with deep gravity. Movement path: Jesus remains still with centered stance, eyes fixed, delivering solemn lip-synced teaching on blasphemy against Holy Spirit.

Spatial layout: Interior house space showing scribes and crowd reaction. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Principal scribe, Middle-aged scribe, and Stern spokesperson stand screen-left; Jesus stands screen-right background. Prop positions: Earthen floor and walls. Sightlines: Scribes stare screen-right at Jesus in shocked silence. Movement path: Scribes remain frozen with clenched jaws and widened eyes, silent and motionless following Jesus' warning.

Spatial layout: Entryway threshold of house linking interior and exterior. Entrances/exits: Main exterior door threshold screen-left. Actor positions: Crowd witnesses stand at doorway threshold. Prop positions: Wooden door frame and exterior wall. Sightlines: Doorway witness looks screen-left outside, then turns head screen-right into interior. Movement path: Witness at door leans outward screen-left, receives word from outside, then turns head screen-right to whisper message to neighbor inside.

Spatial layout: Interior floor space of house where crowd sits around Jesus. Entrances/exits: Doorway screen-left background. Actor positions: Stern spokesperson sits screen-left; Jesus sits screen-right on floor mat. Prop positions: Straw floor mats. Sightlines: Spokesperson turns screen-right to look at Jesus; Jesus looks screen-left at spokesperson. Movement path: Spokesperson leans torso screen-right and points gently toward doorway while delivering lip-synced message regarding his family outside.

Spatial layout: Center of seated crowd circle inside house. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus sits cross-legged on floor mat center screen-right; Elder sits screen-left. Prop positions: Straw floor mats. Sightlines: Jesus looks screen-left at spokesperson and crowd. Movement path: Jesus swivels torso slowly across seated circle, hands resting loosely on knees while asking lip-synced question 'Who are my mother and my brothers?'.

Spatial layout: Interior circle of seated crowd members. Entrances/exits: None. Actor positions: Jesus sits center; Crowd witnesses sit in circle screen-right. Sightlines: Jesus looks warmly toward surrounding listeners. directions.instruction: 35mm lens, medium wide tracking shot. Jesus enters from rear doorway screen-left stepping onto the limestone threshold in an off-white flax tunic with blue vertical clavi and cream mantle. He takes measured strides forward along the central aisle of the 1st-century limestone synagogue. Religious leaders (Principal scribe, Stout scribe in dark charcoal wool robes with magenta clavi, corner tzitzit, and dark headwraps) and crowd witnesses sit on perimeter stone benches screen-right watching with silent scrutiny. High-angled warm mid-morning sun (5000K) streams through high clerestory windows screen-left creating dusty light beams against stone walls, balanced by soft interior ambient bounce (3400K).

50mm prime, medium shot with slow push-in. Frame Principal scribe, Middle-aged scribe, and Younger scribe seated side-by-side on the stone bench along the limestone wall screen-right, staring screen-left toward the central aisle with rigid, suspicious posture and closed mouths. They wear formal dark charcoal wool tunics and draped mantles with dark magenta clavi and corner tzitzit. High clerestory window beam (5000K) lights their faces from front-quarter left, balanced by soft shadowed stone ambient (3200K) keeping dark wool detail clear without blowing out forehead wraps.

65mm portrait lens, medium close-up. Static framing on Jesus standing screen-left facing screen-right in his cream flax tunic with blue vertical clavi and light cream mantle. He swivels his chest screen-right and extends an open palm toward the Man with Withered Hand (seated screen-right in light cream tunic with blue clavi and brown mantle over his contracted left shoulder), beckoning him to stand in the central floor space without touching him. Directional window beam (4800K) illuminates Jesus' lower face and lips for precise lip-sync alignment on source audio segment 567e1949-4ecb-4e9b-9dc9-2df5a3bdd2c5 ('Come here').

50mm prime, medium close-up with slow creep-in. Jesus stands centered screen-left, pivoting his upper body screen-left to face the seated scribes directly, raising open hands to chest level with palms forward. He wears his signature cream tunic with blue vertical clavi and draped mantle. Clear front-quarter clerestory light shaft (4800K) illuminates his mouth and lower face for lip-sync accuracy during his Sabbath question on source audio segment 6563e2f8-0088-4c75-bd96-bfa8769e654c, backed by soft ambient floor bounce (3200K).

50mm prime, static medium group shot. Scribes (Principal scribe, Stout scribe in dark charcoal wool) and Stern spokesperson (brown tunic, navy clavi, cream mantle) sit clustered screen-right looking screen-left toward Jesus. Palms rest flat on tunic knees, bodies settled back against stone wall, lips pressed tightly shut in stoic silence. High window beam (5000K) from upper-left casts dramatic contrast across facial features and headwraps against deep limestone shadow ambient (3000K).

85mm telephoto, medium close-up with smooth push-in. Jesus stands screen-left in his blue-striped cream tunic and mantle. His gaze sweeps deliberately screen-left across the scribes before locking screen-right on the man, extending his right arm toward the man's withered arm with an expression blending grieved sadness and righteous anger. Warm golden sun shaft (4800K) highlights his face and mouth for lip-synced command on source audio segment 3930cb5c-646b-48cc-b8ad-3f159efa8749 ('Stretch out your hand').

90mm macro lens, static insert detail shot. Tight framing on the Man with Withered Hand's anatomical left arm and chest. The contracted arm extends forward away from his light cream tunic (with blue clavus stripe), and the contracted fingers unfurl and straighten completely as muscle tension dissolves into full restoration under a high window sun beam (5200K). Pre-rigged morph targets maintain smooth animation.

28mm wide lens, wide shot with smooth pull-out moving backward toward synagogue entry. Principal scribe, Middle-aged scribe, and Younger scribe screen-right push off stone wall benches and walk briskly screen-left through the heavy timber main entry doors. Bright exterior midday sunlight (5600K) streams through the open doorway, creating rim light on their dark charcoal wool robes against dark interior limestone walls.

35mm wide lens, wide lateral tracking shot moving screen-left to screen-right along the Sea of Galilee shoreline. Jesus (cream tunic, blue clavi) leads his disciples (Peter in rust mantle, Andrew in off-white, James Zebedee in terracotta mantle, John in teal motifs, Matthew in grey tunic/teal mantle) followed by a massive, diverse regional crowd in authentic historical tunics and mantles. Direct overhead midday sun (5600K) with soft water reflection fill (6000K) illuminates the shoreline; a small wooden fishing boat is docked at water's edge in the background.

50mm prime, static medium shot. Jesus stands screen-right resting his right hand on the gunwale of a small wooden Galilean fishing boat resting on pebbled sand, gesturing with his left hand as he instructs disciples (Peter, Andrew, James, John, Matthew) clustered screen-left. Direct overhead sun (5600K) with soft lake bounce (5800K) illuminates warm skin tones and fabric textures.

40mm lens, medium wide handheld follow shot with controlled depth of field. Camera weaves among the pressing crowd (Crowd witness with headwrap, Young man, Elder, Older woman in earth-brown dress) reaching screen-left and screen-right toward Jesus near the water's edge. Direct overhead sun (5600K) and diffuse shoreline bounce (5800K) keep faces exposed as hands reach for Jesus' mantle hem.

65mm portrait lens, medium close-up with slow push-in. The Man with Unclean Spirit in a ragged, frayed earth-brown tunic drops abruptly to his knees screen-left before Jesus standing screen-right, tilting his torso back with head facing skyward and mouth wide open. Direct sun (5600K) and sand bounce (5800K) illuminate his face and open mouth for precise lip sync on source audio segment ead1da4a-08a2-4ba2-b06b-3eee93e69d6b ('You are the Son of God').

85mm portrait lens, static medium close over-the-shoulder shot framing the kneeling man foreground screen-left. Jesus stands background screen-right in his blue-striped cream tunic, looking down screen-left with firm authority and lowering his right hand in a deliberate palm-down motion while shaking his head to command silence. High overhead sun (5600K) with soft sand bounce illuminates his expression.

40mm prime, static medium wide shot. Simon Peter (cream tunic, rust-red mantle over shoulders), James Zebedee (cream tunic, terracotta-red mantle), and John (cream tunic, teal clavi/gamma motifs) stand grouped screen-left facing Jesus screen-right on the mountain peak. 35mm lens, medium wide tracking shot moving laterally with subtle framing pauses across the remaining nine apostles (Andrew, Philip in mustard tunic, Bartholomew, Matthew in light grey, Thomas, James Alphaeus, Thaddaeus in aubergine tunic, Simon Zealot, Judas Iscariot in olive/crimson) gathered on the mountain slope screen-left looking screen-right toward Jesus off-screen. Inside a rustic mudbrick Capernaum home, Jesus and his disciples sit/stand near a low wooden table with untouched flatbread, tightly surrounded by an overflowing crowd crowding the central room and screen-left doorway, leaving no space to eat. Crowd witnesses (Stern spokesperson, Man with headwrap, Young man) stand screen-left outside, leaning against exterior mudbrick walls, whispering and gesturing down an open exterior path screen-left discussing news of Jesus' family coming to restrain him. Direct exterior midday sunlight (5600K) keys the crowd with soft doorway frame reflections.

65mm portrait lens, static medium close-up. Jesus maintains his centered position screen-right, swiveling his torso slightly left and right with hand gestures illustrating a divided kingdom and house. 50mm prime, medium close-up with push-in. 85mm prime, static close-up portrait. Jesus faces screen-center/left with eyes locked in a solemn gaze. 50mm prime, medium shot with slow pull-out. Jerusalem scribes (Principal scribe, Middle-aged scribe) and Stern spokesperson stand screen-left facing screen-right in shocked, silent reaction with clenched jaws and widened eyes following Jesus' warning. Doorway light beam (4500K) and soft shadow ambient (3000K) capture the tense, unmoving atmosphere.

35mm lens, static medium wide shot at the main entryway threshold. Crowd witnesses stand at the doorway frame; one witness leans outward screen-left, receives word from outside, and turns head screen-right to whisper inward into the room that Jesus' mother and brothers are calling. Bright daytime exterior light (5200K) spills through the doorway into the warm earth-toned interior.

50mm prime, medium close-up with pan-left. Stern spokesperson seated cross-legged on a floor mat screen-left leans toward Jesus seated screen-right, pointing gently toward the doorway while relaying the message. Warm daytime light from open doorway (4800K) and straw mat bounce (3200K) illuminate his lower face for lip sync on source audio segment 05af82fe-f43f-45eb-8e7c-7137bc5132f5.

65mm portrait lens, static medium close-up. entries.summary: Mark 3 establishes five major emotional movements: rigid religious confrontation and compassionate healing in the synagogue (vv. 1-6), urgent press of suffering crowds by the Sea of Galilee with demonic submission (vv. 7-12), solemn appointment of the Twelve Apostles on the mountain (vv. 13-19), sharp conflict over Beelzebul and solemn parables in a crowded Capernaum home (vv. 20-30), and the intimate redefinition of family based on doing God's will (vv. 31-35). Directives maintain strict visual continuity, Papuan casting canon, historical accuracy, and exact scriptural alignment.

Center framing on Jesus calling the man forward. Ensure lower-face visibility is completely unobstructed so viewers clearly connect his spoken command with his beckoning hand gesture toward the man.

Jesus turns to face the scribes directly; keep the visual line of sight clear across the open floor space so first viewers easily trace the direct verbal challenge directed at the silent religious leaders.

Wide pull-out shot shows the Pharisees and scribes standing abruptly and exiting through rear pivot doors; ensure their exit is sudden and tense to clarify their intent to conspire outside.

Push-in low angle shot on possessed man falling to his knees before Jesus; ensure his sudden collapse and upturned face clearly signal spiritual submission rather than physical attack.

entries.summary: Picture editing plan for Mark Chapter 3 establishes visual rhythm, performance pacing, and cut points across thirty shots. The editing structure transitions from tense, deliberate cuts in the synagogue Sabbath confrontation to dynamic coastal tracking on the Galilean shore, expansive elevated holds during the mountain commissioning of the Twelve, tight claustrophobic cuts during the Capernaum domestic accusation, and intimate circular panning cuts for redefining the spiritual family.

directions.instruction: Cut in on Jesus entering through the synagogue doorway; hold tracking rhythm to establish synagogue environment and resting position of the man with the withered hand before cutting to observing scribes.

Hold edit on low-angle frame of Jesus addressing scribes; maintain steady cut duration to convey moral weight during his direct question.
Cut to over-the-shoulder reaction shot of silent scribes; extend duration slightly to emphasize lingering, sullen silence.
Cut back to medium close-up of Jesus as he sweeps his gaze in grief/anger; push-in builds momentum prior to the command to stretch out hand.
Match-cut to insert detail of restoring hand; time duration smoothly with physical uncurling action for maximum visual payoff.
Hard cut to wide pull-out as Pharisees abruptly rise and exit; quicken editing pace to reflect sudden conspiracy motion.

entries.summary: As script supervisor for Mark 4 (Phase: planning, pass 1/2), I have conducted a comprehensive continuity audit across all 70 shots. This check verifies narrative sequence, speaker assignments, location transitions (Galilean shore to grassy knoll, stone terrace, boat deck, and open stormy sea), costume states (from dry flax/wool to water-saturated, clinging garments during the tempest), prop placements, eyelines, and character entrances/exits. Nonverbal emotional reactions—such as the disciples' urgent physical waking of Jesus during the gale and their subsequent stunned astonishment—are strictly constrained to physical actions to prevent unscripted lip sync or invented speech. Per producer guidelines, the spoken chapter title 'MARKUS 4' is handled as pre-source editorial audio before verse 1, and the post-source crossing transition toward the Gerasenes is held as a proposed bridge pending target review, fully protecting Mark 4's final narrated words.

entries.summary: As HeartWord's picture editor for Mark 4 (Phase: planning, pass 1/2), I have evaluated the shot-to-shot rhythm, performance transitions, character eyelines, and coverage across all 70 shots against the Hatam source audio. The visual rhythm establishes three major narrative movements: public parabolic teaching along the Sea of Galilee shoreline from the anchored boat (Mark 4:1-9, 21-34), intimate private instruction with the Twelve on the grassy knoll and olive terrace (Mark 4:10-20, 34), and the sudden storm crossing where physical panic and desperate nonverbal action transition into breathless, moonlit awe as Jesus calms the wind and waves (Mark 4:35-41). All nonverbal emotional beats—such as the disciples waking Jesus in the stern and Peter's whispered astonishment to John—are strictly constrained to physical behavior to prevent unscripted lip sync or invented dialogue during narration. No whole cut is assembled in Pass 1, so editorialChecks is returned empty.
